experiment.hypothesis: After a 2% gap-down event in BTC-USD, the price mean reverts within 30 hours with a 90% probability of returning to within 5% of the pre-gap level.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: For any 2% gap-down event in BTC-USD, the 30-hour return must be strictly greater than 5% in at least 10% of cases to falsify the claim.
